---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, item, mini-game, or mechanical improvement for HavenWorld
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of what feature you'd like to see implemented.

## 🎯 Problem or Motivation
What problem does this feature solve, or what player experience does it elevate? (e.g. "Currently, lofts can only be decorated by the owner; co-op building with friends would make hosting events better.")

## 🎨 Proposed Solution & Gameplay Loop
Describe how you envision the feature working:
- What does the player click or interact with?
- Does it affect the economy (Coins / Gems)?
- How does the server validate the action?

## 🖼️ Visual Mockups or References
If applicable, share isometric sketches, YoWorld / MegaPlanet inspirations, or layout ideas.

## ⚖️ Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or game loops you considered?

## 📝 Additional Context
Any other notes, edge cases, or future extensions.
